messages:
Maria R.: Quick heads-up — planned deploy for inference-runtime v2.4.1 tonight 22:00 UTC. Need smoke owners and a clear rollback owner. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/escape-plan-2024 :spiral_note_pad:
Jun K.: I can own smoke checks for the API surface (latency, 5xxs). I’ll be on call 21:30-23:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Sam T.: I’ll be backup for Jun and will watch GPU pool metrics + queue depth. Also can flip feature toggle if needed.
Carol B.: I’ll take rollback owner — if error rate >1% sustained for 5m or latency P95 doubles, I’ll trigger. Confirming I have access to deployctl.
Maria R.: Thanks — Carol is rollback owner. Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity: model loads, sample prompt returns within 500ms
- latency: P95 < 800ms for common routes
- errors: 5xx < 0.5% (alert at 1%)
- infra: GPU mem pressure < 80% and queue depth < 50
Jun K.: copying checklist into #eng-oncall notes.
deploy-bot: preflight checks queued: image digest verified, canary slot healthy. CI status: all green.
Sam T.: Quick question — which toggle is the safe-exit? I have two toggles (runtime_fastpath, runtime_stable).
Maria R.: runtime_stable is the safe-exit toggle. Flip sequence in runbook: 1) set runtime_stable=false 2) revert deployment 3) set runtime_stable=true.
Carol B.: Put the rollback command here for quick copy:
```
# rollback to previous release
deployctl rollback --service inference-runtime --to-tag v2.4.0 --confirm --reason "hotfix rollback"
```
Jun K.: Who hits the switch if we see intermittent 5xx spike but not yet 1%? Triage first or immediate rollback?
Carol B.: Triage first: 2-min triage window. If errors persist or error budget breached during triage, I’ll execute rollback. Otherwise follow mitigation section (scale pool, drop canary).
Sam T.: I’ll run a canary-only load with 50 req/s post-deploy for 10m to validate. Will post results.
Maria R.: Timeline recap: 21:40 UTC — owners online, 22:00 deploy starts, 22:10 canary verification, 22:20 canary exit + 22:30 full rollout. Silent window until 23:30.
Jun K.: ACK. I’ll post smoke results to this thread.
Sam T.: ACK — will run canary load and watch metrics.
Carol B.: ACK — have rollback command ready. If I say "NO-GO" here, consider rollback immediate.
Maria R.: One more: if POST-deploy errors correlate with model-serving GPU OOMs, fallback plan is to switch model to smaller checkpoint (see runbook section 3.2). Carol, will you coordinate?
Carol B.: Yes — I can flip to the smaller model and coordinate with Sam to drain caches.
deploy-bot: reminder: runbook verification passed (checksums match). Scheduled deploy job id: dj-214800-001.
Jun K.: Go/no-go: smoke (canary) looks fine at 22:12 — P95 420ms, 5xx 0.02%. :white_check_mark:
Sam T.: Canary load done 22:20 — stable. No GPU mem spikes. :white_check_mark:
Carol B.: All good from my side. Rollback holders present. GO for full rollout at 22:30. :rocket:
Maria R.: Thanks everyone — tagging release notes and I’ll close thread once rollout complete. :tada:
